# Lindsay Ash

Lindsay Ash is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2018.

Lindsay Ash has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lindsay-ash#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Clement with 48% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/lindsay-ash-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JkQiIta2e4E)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bfgoiOSPBh4)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lindsay-ash#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/lindsay-ash/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aKncfwIKlhs)

Lindsay Ash has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 8](https://flow.je/elections/district-8). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/12/ex-assistant-minister-hopes-to-return-to-political-fray/)\]

## Election History

### 2018 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Clement](https://flow.je/elections/st-clement) (2 seats), 16th May 2018.

**Lindsay Ash was elected as Deputy of St Clement in 2018**.
